result.title: TRIAGE: Reliability- and Load-Conditioned Escalation for Two-Tier LLM Serving with a Semantic Evidence Judge
result.summary: Two-tier LLM serving escalates selected requests from a small model to a large one, but prompt-based routers cannot see whether retrieved evidence supports an answer, and they treat the GPU cost of an escalation as constant. We study TRIAGE, which conditions escalation on a post-generation reliability state and on a load-dependent GPU price, and we report both what held and what did not on one A40 serving Qwen2.5-7B and 32B (AWQ) under VLLM. Escalation cost rose 21.9x from 1 to 10 requests/s but showed no monotone dependence on KV-cache headroom, and a pre-registered claim that the reliability state detects corrupted evidence (AUROC>=0.70) was falsified at 0.571, although any prompt-only router scores exactly 0.500 by construction. Post hoc, a semantic evidence judge raised detection to 0.846 (0.926 on never-served items) and predicted wrong small-model answers at AUROC 0.90-0.96 on RGB and three RouterBench model pairs; the resulting cascade stayed within about 3 pp of GPT-4 at 79.5% lower API cost for GPT-3.5->GPT-4, yet fell below random routing for open-model pairs with 2-3x price ratios. End to end, the 7B->32B pair showed only a +2.88 pp held-out gap, so the allocator rightly declined to escalate and the headline is a null that a small pre-launch gate failed to expose.

AI.brief_summary: 研究两层 LLM 服务中是否把小模型请求升级到大模型：以生成后的可靠性状态和负载相关的 GPU 价格作为升级条件，在单张 A40 上部署 Qwen2.5-7B 与 32B，同时报告预注册的「可靠性状态能检测被污染证据」假设被否证，以及事后语义证据判官在检测与级联成本上的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义证据判官」判断检索证据是否支持答案，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与「是否值得继续 LOOK/THINK」的触发信号提供线索；可靠性探测失败的负结果也对 latent 可靠性估计有参考，但该工作为纯文本服务场景，迁移到多模态需核查。
